blogs.title: Breaking the 2‑Million Token Barrier: How LongRoPE Re‑defines LLM Context Windows
blogs.description: A high‑level overview of what a context window is, why the 4k limit has stuck, and how LongRoPE’s evolutionary search for “non‑uniform” positional embedding lets a pre‑trained LLaMA2 or Mistral run with 2,048,000 tokens without rewiring the whole model. The post explains the three key innovations—deep search for RoPE scaling, progressive fine‑tuning, and short‑window recovery—in plain language.

blogs.title: Unearthing Non‑Uniformity: The Secret Behind RoPE’s Hidden Power
blogs.description: An accessible deep dive into Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE), the two forms of non‑uniformity (dimension vs token position), and why most previous interpolation techniques ignore them. Readers learn what the evolutionary search actually does—finding per‑dimension scale factors—and how keeping the first few tokens unscaled preserves attention focus.

blogs.title: The One‑Step Fine‑Tune: Reaching a Million Tokens with Just 1,000 Gradient Updates
blogs.description: Step‐by‐step guide to LongRoPE's progressive extension pipeline: start with a pre‑trained LLM, use LongRoPE to stretch its window from 4k to 256k at the –8× interpolation level, fine‑tune for only ~1k steps, then do a second interpolation pass to jump to 2M. This plan keeps GPU costs low while unlocking extreme document lengths.

blogs.title: How to Keep Short Context Magic Intact After A 512× Window Upscale
blogs.description: LongRoPE extends context size but sometimes hurts performance on the original small inputs. This post walks through the “short window recovery” trick—searching new RoPE scales for the first few kilobytes—to explain why it works and how it can be applied in any extended LLM.

blogs.title: Beyond Long Documents: Real‑World Tasks That Benefit From Ultralong Context
blogs.description: "Passkey retrieval", long‑form summarization, in‑context coding problems and multi‑step reasoning all care about the amount of text an LLM can keep in mind. The article links OpenAI benchmarks, Hugging Face Leaderboard results and LongRoPE’s improvements to show concrete applications and performance gains.
